results.description:
Ten acclaimed authors. Ten original mysteries. Sherlock Holmes returns.

In this thrilling new collection, the world’s greatest detective is reimagined by some of the finest writers at work today. From the gaslit streets of Baker Street to cases that test even Holmes’s legendary powers of deduction, these brand-new stories honour Arthur Conan Doyle’s immortal creation while bringing fresh ingenuity, atmosphere and suspense to his world.

Featuring original stories by Anthony Horowitz, Kate Mosse, Joe Hill, Sarah Perry, Janice Hallett, S. A. Cosby, Steve Cavanagh, Vaseem Khan, Abir Mukherjee and G. T. Karber, with an introduction by Stephen Fry, this is Sherlock Holmes as you’ve never read him before - and everything you have always loved him for.
